# The Cloud Rain

> The Cloud Rain (https://thecloudrain.org) is a curated, verified directory of 375+ lightweight open-source tools, self-hostable software, and privacy-focused alternatives to expensive proprietary SaaS platforms.

The Cloud Rain is designed for builders, indie hackers, self-hosters, and engineering teams seeking full data ownership, $0 subscription costs, and transparent open-source licenses. Every listed project includes GitHub star metrics, SPDX license verification, primary programming languages, and direct deployment options.

## Core Platform Navigation

- [Open-Source Tools Directory](https://thecloudrain.org/free-tools): Browse and search 375+ verified open-source developer tools, utilities, and applications.
- [SaaS Alternatives Matrix](https://thecloudrain.org/alternatives): Find curated open-source replacements for major commercial software (Notion, Jira, Firebase, HubSpot, Airtable, etc.).
- [Head-to-Head Comparisons](https://thecloudrain.org/vs): Detailed feature, license, and self-hosting breakdowns between open-source projects and commercial SaaS.
- [Tool Deep Dives & Articles](https://thecloudrain.org/article-museum): Long-form evaluations, setup guides, and architectural overviews.
- [Weekly Roundups](https://thecloudrain.org/weekly-roundups): Weekly editorial highlights of newly discovered open-source gems.
- [XML Sitemap](https://thecloudrain.org/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable index of canonical pages.

## Curated SaaS-to-Open-Source Replacements

### Notion Alternatives
- [AppFlowy](https://thecloudrain.org/tools/appflowy): Local-first, privacy-focused workspace for notes, wikis, and project tasks. Built with Flutter and Rust. (72k+ GitHub Stars, AGPL-3.0)
- [Memos](https://thecloudrain.org/tools/memos): Lightweight, self-hosted memo and knowledge hub using SQLite. (60k+ GitHub Stars, MIT)
- [Joplin](https://thecloudrain.org/tools/joplin): Secure, end-to-end encrypted note taking and to-do application with mobile and desktop sync. (55k+ GitHub Stars, AGPL-3.0)

### Jira & Linear Alternatives
- [Plane](https://thecloudrain.org/tools/plane): Modern project planning, issue tracking, and product roadmaps with Docker and Kubernetes self-hosting support. (AGPL-3.0)
- [Plane vs Jira Comparison](https://thecloudrain.org/vs/plane-vs-jira): Full breakdown of features, self-hosting difficulty, and pricing.

### Firebase & Backend-as-a-Service Alternatives
- [PocketBase](https://thecloudrain.org/tools/pocketbase): Single-binary Go backend with embedded SQLite, real-time subscriptions, auth, and file storage. (59k+ GitHub Stars, MIT)
- [Supabase](https://thecloudrain.org/tools/supabase): Open-source Firebase alternative providing Postgres, Auth, Instant APIs, Realtime subscriptions, and Storage. (Apache-2.0)
- [Appwrite](https://thecloudrain.org/tools/appwrite): Complete backend server for web, mobile, and native developers with auth, databases, and serverless cloud functions. (56k+ GitHub Stars, BSD-3-Clause)

### Algolia & Search Alternatives
- [MeiliSearch](https://thecloudrain.org/tools/meilisearch): Blazing fast, typo-tolerant search engine API designed to be a drop-in replacement for Algolia. Built in Rust. (58k+ GitHub Stars, MIT)

### HubSpot & Salesforce Alternatives
- [Twenty](https://thecloudrain.org/tools/twenty): Modern, extensible open-source CRM with visual pipelines, full data ownership, and clean design. (57k+ GitHub Stars, AGPL-3.0)

### GitHub & GitLab Alternatives
- [Gitea](https://thecloudrain.org/tools/gitea): Lightweight, self-hosted Git service written in Go. Minimal hardware requirements. (56k+ GitHub Stars, MIT)

### Google Analytics Alternatives
- [Plausible](https://thecloudrain.org/tools/plausible): Simple, lightweight (< 1 KB script), cookie-free, privacy-compliant web analytics. (AGPL-3.0)

### Heroku, Vercel & Cloud PaaS Alternatives
- [Coolify](https://thecloudrain.org/tools/coolify): Self-hosted, all-in-one PaaS to deploy applications, databases, and WordPress on any Linux VPS with 1-click simplicity. (Apache-2.0)

### Presentation & Content Tools
- [reveal.js](https://thecloudrain.org/tools/revealjs): The HTML presentation framework for creating beautiful, code-rich interactive slides. (71k+ GitHub Stars, MIT)

## Categories

- [Developer Tools](https://thecloudrain.org/free-tools?category=developer-tools): Compilers, CLIs, debuggers, API clients, and code generation utilities.
- [Self-Hosting & Infrastructure](https://thecloudrain.org/free-tools?category=self-hosting-infrastructure): Docker containers, server management, monitoring, reverse proxies, and PaaS.
- [Analytics & Search](https://thecloudrain.org/free-tools?category=analytics-search): Privacy-first analytics, full-text search engines, metrics, and error tracking.
- [Media & Utilities](https://thecloudrain.org/free-tools?category=media-utilities): Image processing, video encoding, format converters, and audio tools.
- [Productivity](https://thecloudrain.org/free-tools?category=productivity): Note taking, task management, calendars, and documentation wikis.
- [Security](https://thecloudrain.org/free-tools?category=security): Identity management, vault storage, authentication, and vulnerability scanning.
- [Business Tools](https://thecloudrain.org/free-tools?category=business-tools): CRMs, invoicing, accounting, customer support, and billing systems.
- [Community & Events](https://thecloudrain.org/free-tools?category=community-events): Forum software, chat platforms, event scheduling, and community hubs.

## Evaluation & Inclusion Criteria

1. **Source Code Availability**: Project source code must be publicly available on GitHub, GitLab, or a self-hosted Git forge.
2. **Open-Source License**: Software must use recognized open-source or source-available licenses (MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL, AGPL, BSD, MPL).
3. **Active Maintenance**: Projects are monitored for commit recency, release cadence, and active maintainer responsiveness.
4. **Self-Hostability**: Preference is given to tools with straightforward self-hosting options (Docker Compose, single-binary binaries, Kubernetes helm charts).
5. **No Stealth Paywalls**: Core features must be genuinely usable without forced enterprise licensing or hidden telemetry requirements.
